title: A 10<SUP>10</SUP> Solar Mass Flow of Molecular Gas in the A1835 Brightest Cluster Galaxy
question: Does radio-mechanical AGN feedback in the Abell 1835 BCG affect its molecular gas, e.g. by driving a molecular outflow?

data.arrays: Cycle 0 extended array, on average twenty 12 m dishes
data.angular_resolution: 0.5 arcsec at CO(3-2), 1.5 arcsec at CO(1-0)
data.sensitivity: rms in line-free channels 0.6 mJy (CO 1-0), 1.6 mJy (CO 3-2)

evidence.loc: 5.2 Driving a Molecular Outflow by Radiation Pressure or Supernovae
evidence.quote: Based on the far UV flux from O’Dea et al. (2010), $L_{\rm FUV}=1.85 \times 10^{43}~\rm erg~s^{-1}$

evidence.loc: 4.2 Central Molecular Gas and Star Formation
evidence.quote: upward of $100-180~\rm M_\odot ~yr^{-1}$ (M06, Egami et al. 2006, Donahue et al. 2011, )

external_data.citation: M06, Egami et al. 2006, Donahue et al. 2011

evidence.quote: At the emission line redshift z = 0.252 (Crawford et al. 1999), 1 arcsec = 3.9 kpc.

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image CO cubes and continuum
recipe.method: CASA calibration per ALMA scripts, CLEAN of continuum-subtracted cubes, continuum from line-free channels
key_parameters: Briggs robust 0.5, polygon mask, 20 km/s channels

recipe.goal: Fit total spectra and derive molecular gas mass
recipe.method: Single Gaussian fit to continuum-subtracted spectra; mass from CO(1-0) integral with XCO

recipe.goal: Map velocity field on grids and isolate high-velocity gas
recipe.method: Grid of spectra with Gaussian fits per box; 2D Gaussian fitted and subtracted per channel in CO(1-0) to remove central emission; integrate wings

recipe.goal: Estimate outflow rate and disk dynamics
recipe.method: Outflow mass divided by buoyant rise or gas travel time; Toomre Q, pressure and scale height analytic estimates
assumptions: gas to dust ratio 100; R_e=2 kpc encloses half the mass; v_c=400 km/s

evidence.quote: This expression yields a total molecular gas mass of $4.9 \pm 0.2 \times 10^{10} ~M_{\odot}$.
